context.person: A person using an AI image creation tool
context.user_goal: Remove personal information or keep the work private.

product_state.preceding_state: A creator is about to publish a generated image and prompt to a public gallery.
product_state.current_state: Publishing makes the image and prompt visible to anyone. The prompt contains a person's full name.
known_facts: Publishing makes the image and prompt visible to anyone.
The prompt contains a person's full name.
Removing the name does not alter the saved private version.
The publication can be deleted later, but downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
forbidden_claims: Only followers can view the publication.

challenge: Rewrite the decision or recovery dialog so the person can understand generated image public-sharing warning, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Edit the public prompt before publishing.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Publishing may expose personal information beyond the creator's control.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Remove personal information or keep the work private.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
